summary_1line: Duryodhana boasts of his superior warriors and army, while Sanjaya reports the Pandavas’ confidence and vividly describes Arjuna’s divine chariot and banner.

image_candidates.scene_text: Arjuna stands armored on a radiant celestial chariot while a vast, ever-changing banner bearing Hanuman billows across the sky.
A hundred white celestial horses, swift as thought, are yoked to Arjuna’s chariot as it gleams in all directions like lightning within clouds.
Duryodhana confidently addresses Dhritarashtra’s court, gesturing as he lists his mighty warriors and vast eleven Akshauhini army.
